_notes: Points of interest (docs/COMMUNITY_RPG.md). Worldgen places them per biome, deterministically from the seed. Each has a small challenge (kind: offering | effort | lamps | sequence | guard) and a reward that comes back every week (claimed_week < current week). loot = {item: [min, max]} rolled from a hash of (seed, poi, week). discover = one-off fog-of-war reward. Nothing here needs another player.

types.name: Derelict Farm
types.flavor: A fallen barn, a furrow that still remembers rain.

challenge.text: Replant the old furrow with one glowfruit seed.

types.name: Fungal Cave
types.flavor: A glowing mouth in the hillside; the air hums.

challenge.text: Drive off the sporelings nesting inside.

types.name: Wayside Shrine
types.flavor: Three stone lamps and a little bowl for the rain.

challenge.text: Light the three lamps in the pattern carved on the bowl.

types.name: Ruin Vault
types.flavor: A sealed door with three glyph plates beneath old moss.

challenge.text: Press the three glyph plates in the order the lintel shows.

types.name: Stranded Wreck
types.flavor: A hull of grey timber, stranded when the water drew back.

challenge.text: Spend your strength prying the hold open.

types.name: Hermit's Hut
types.flavor: Smoke from a crooked chimney. Someone hums inside.

challenge.text: Leave a ration on the step; the hermit leaves something in return.

types.name: Salt Spire
types.flavor: A tower of crystal, ringing faintly in the wind.

challenge.text: A thorn slinger guards the foot of the spire.
